_comment: NSE equity-segment trading holidays, one entry per non-trading day.
PROVENANCE: the 2026 dates below were transcribed from a secondary
source (broker/aggregator summaries of NSE's circular), NOT read from
nseindia.com directly - this environment's egress proxy blocks that
host. They pass the mechanical checks in tests/test_holidays.py: every
date's weekday matches what the source claimed, and none falls on a
weekend. Please spot-check them against the official list before
relying on this in anger:
https://www.nseindia.com/resources/exchange-communication-holidays
(Trading Holidays tab, Equities segment; also served as JSON at
https://www.nseindia.com/api/holiday-master?type=trading)
2027 IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY. The 2027 list that turned up in search was
checked and rejected: 5 of its 14 dates fall on a Saturday or Sunday,
so it is a list of festival dates rather than trading holidays, and it
omits Diwali, Dussehra, Guru Nanak Jayanti and Christmas entirely.
Loading it would tell this app the market is OPEN on Diwali 2027.
Fill 2027 in from the official circular when NSE publishes it.
Weekends are handled in code and must NOT be listed here - NSE does
not publish a weekend date as a trading holiday, which is exactly the
signal that caught the bad 2027 list.
Holidays that fall on a weekend in 2026, correctly absent below:
2026-02-15 Sun Mahashivratri, 2026-03-21 Sat Id-ul-Fitr,
2026-08-15 Sat Independence Day, 2026-11-08 Sun Diwali Laxmi Pujan
(NSE runs a Muhurat trading session that evening; this app models
regular sessions only, so it is not listed as a trading day.)
source: Broker/aggregator transcriptions of the NSE 2026 trading-holiday circular; not fetched from nseindia.com (blocked). Verify before relying on it.
